name: @streamline-pulse/creeba-oplog
description: Portable op-log for local-first apps: hybrid logical clock, operation journal and LWW convergence. Persistence-agnostic — the app plugs an OpStore and a Projection (Prisma, SQLite, Drizzle, raw SQL…). No native or ORM dependency. Pairs with @streamline-pulse/creeba-core for P2P transport.
